tonight.headline: No claim tonight — the wire goes free at 01:00
body: Week 4 hasn't started. ESPN has you at 117.2 against Team 13's 112.3, a 52% chance. No starter is in doubt.

Claims process at 01:00 Wednesday Mexico City, overnight, and the answer for IPADE is to claim nobody: priority never resets and nothing on the wire starts for you by more than a coin flip. The move comes after 01:00: if Josh Downs clears, add him free for Lloyd. One lineup tap too: Golden into the flex.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Team 13 start Josh Allen, questionable with a knee contusion Dr. Chao expects him to play through (SI, 29 Sep). If he sits, Lamar starts for them and they lose little.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: An injury on Wednesday's report for Taylor, Barkley, Rice or Wilson. None is expected; Hurts' Monday concussion check is the one to watch for Barkley's passer.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · not a claim · add free after Wed 01:00 if he clears · before Sun 07:30
doFirst.title: If Downs clears: add him free, drop Lloyd
doFirst.subtitle: Lloyd is Green Bay's third back. Downs leads Indianapolis in targets with Pierce on IR. Never spend priority on this.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Lloyd, 67.0% rostered, so this goes against the market on the record. He's Green Bay's RB3: 15 snaps in Week 3 to Brooks' 26 and Kaleb Johnson's 22 (Acme Packing), 4 carries in the archive, 6.5 projected, on a team averaging a league-worst 3.0 yards a carry (SI, 29 Sep). His hold thesis closed WRONG on Tuesday.

case.label: The add
case.body: Downs drew 11 targets in Week 3 (archive), with Alec Pierce on IR (heel). He projects 13.7. Honest competition: Keenan Allen drew 9 and Tyler Warren 10 in the same game, and the Colts' Tuesday depth chart lists Treadwell as a starter (Colts.com, 29 Sep).

case.label: The price
case.body: He's on WAIVERS until 01:00 Wednesday Mexico City. IPADE priority never resets and Bloodsports are 6th, and Downs would start over Golden only by 0.8 — a coin flip, not a starter-level need. So he's an add only as a free agent after he clears. If someone claims him, Michael Wilson on the same terms.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Downs draws under five targets against Washington, or Lloyd outscores Downs in two of the next three weeks.

action.label: Add Downs · drop Lloyd (only after Wed 01:00, only if he cleared)

doFirst.title: Start Golden in the flex over Tate
doFirst.subtitle: A one-point coin flip. The rule is to take the projection, so this is a tap, not a thesis. Not yet made as of 18:18.

case.label: The call
case.body: Golden 12.9, Tate 11.9. Inside the two-point line, where even ESPN is right only 56% of the time. Take the projection.

case.label: The one fact
case.body: Jayden Reed (neck) likely misses a second game and LaFleur has no update (RotoWire, 29 Sep); Golden plays 83% of snaps (DK Network). Neither is a reason to override; they're why the number is what it is.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tate outscores Golden. It's a coin flip, so that happens often and changes nothing about the rule.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing about the method; this week the projection itself puts Golden in the flex.

lineupCheck.verdict: One coin flip: the projection starts Golden (12.9) over Tate (11.9) in the flex. Take the projection and write no thesis. No starter is in doubt.

trades.theirGainLine: Their gain is +4.3 a week: Tuten (12.7) would start over Rachaad White (8.4), and Lamar scores them nothing behind Allen. Bigger than yours — but not this week, when they're your opponent.

case.label: Their surplus
case.body: Re-checked on the 18:18 snapshot: Lamar at slot 20 behind Josh Allen at slot 0; McCaffrey and White start at RB, Blake Corum (8.1) on the bench.

case.label: Your gain
case.body: Lamar 20.3 against Lawrence's 17.5: +2.8 a week. Tuten is your third back and doesn't start. Season projections: Lamar 269.6, Tuten 179.7; both pricings positive for both sides.

case.label: Honest risk
case.body: Team 13 are your Week 4 opponent: accepted before Sunday, their +4.3 comes out of your matchup. Send it after Monday night. Allen's knee is the other risk; if he missed time, Lamar becomes their starter. Baltimore lost both centres long-term (CBS, 29 Sep), which touches Lamar's week but not the surplus. This clears the bar on weekly and season numbers, not on a one-week horizon alone.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Team 13 start a second real back over White, drop or trade a quarterback, or Allen misses time. Don't send until Week 4 is final.

trades.copyText: Hi — after this week's game, would you do Lamar for Bhayshul Tuten? Lamar can't start for you behind Allen, and Tuten (12.7 projected) would start over White for you, about +4 a week on your side.

waiverAnalysis.summary: Nine risers and one faller from three weeks of data, still thin. One riser has a role reason that holds and a seat to go into: Downs, for Lloyd, as a free agent only. The rest are injury fill-ins or one-week spikes, and IPADE priority is never spent on those.
